name: Sable's Grimoire 2
source:
Sable is back as his second year at Amadronia Magic Academy begins at last. As a direct sequel to the first game in the series, Sable's Grimoire 2 features a returning cast of dozens, and several unfamiliar faces as a new grade full of students enter the academy.

Join Sable once again as he continues his research into magic alongside his demi-human friends. Your choices will determine whether his days are spent focused on his studies, advancing his career, or getting closer to the demi-human students and teachers of Amadronia Magic Academy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702740/]Steam[/url]]
